blurb: Discover the captivating Art Deco district in a small group of up to 10 people, on a two-hour tour! Your Francophone guide will immerse you in the fascinating history of this place, sharing anecdotes and secrets. With more than 800 UNESCO-listed buildings since 1979, get ready to admire the shining facades and refined details that make this iconic style famous. Don't miss this unique opportunity to explore elegance and history on every corner
